cloud_model.description: Cloud model for finding and normalizing candidates. Free tier at time of writing.

cloud_model_lite.description: Cloud fallback for PREFER_ON_DEVICE helpers (room helper, explanation).

candidate_source.description: 'maps' = Gemini + Grounding with Google Maps (needs billing; falls back to the demo list on failure); 'fixture' = eval/candidates.sample.json.

max_candidates.description: Must stay <= 10: the tally document and security rules have 10 slots.

attr_version.description: Version of shared/attributes.v1.json both sides must agree on.

prompt_profile.description: Override for the on-device 'understand my note' prompt. Empty = built-in prompt.

prompt_fit.description: Override for the on-device soft-fit scoring prompt. Empty = built-in prompt.
